profile.prompt_summary: Fast one-card reasoning and coding helper for bounded implementation, search, tools, drafting, and synthesis; use GLM-5.2 or another supervisor for the hardest long-horizon work.
strengths: Its three-billion-active MoE architecture makes it a fast coding, browsing, and agent worker for its total size.
Useful qualitative quality-throughput balance for a single 96 GB deployment.
limitations: Not the preferred final authority when larger high-intelligence routes are available.
Agent behavior depends on preserving its thinking and tool-template semantics.
prompting: Use the exact GLM template and tool schema; preserve thinking across multi-turn agent tasks and define a bounded completion condition.

evidence.notes: Architecture and intended capabilities are publisher-backed; precise PreFer role and speed judgment still needs route-level experience.
